can i apply if i failed a subject?.reply: No. You can't apply with a failed subject from your last semester. You can apply in a later round once you have passed it.
can i apply if i failed a subject?.reply_english: No. You can't apply with a failed subject from your last semester. You can apply in a later round once you have passed it.

quale voto serve per l'erasmus?.reply: Ti serve una media di almeno 6 su 10 nel tuo ultimo semestre. Alcune università chiedono un voto più alto.
quale voto serve per l'erasmus?.reply_english: You need an average of at least 6 out of 10 in your last semester. Some universities ask for a higher grade.

how do i apply?.reply: Email the Erasmus office with your last semester average, whether you failed any subject, your field of study, your English level and the countries you prefer. You can attach your transcript.
how do i apply?.reply_english: Email the Erasmus office with your last semester average, whether you failed any subject, your field of study, your English level and the countries you prefer. You can attach your transcript.

¿puedo elegir la universidad?.reply: Sí. La oficina te envía las opciones que se ajustan a tu perfil y tú eliges a cuál solicitar. No se garantiza una plaza, porque las plazas son limitadas.
¿puedo elegir la universidad?.reply_english: Yes. The office sends the options that fit your profile and you choose which to apply for. A place isn't guaranteed, because places are limited.

what level of english do i need?.reply: Most partner universities ask for B1 or B2. A few ask for C1.
what level of english do i need?.reply_english: Most partner universities ask for B1 or B2. A few ask for C1.

i think my rejection is wrong.reply: Reply to the email with the correct details and the office will look again. You can also book a meeting with the office.
